## 1. Goal

Give the website one calm design system and a simple shell: three numbered steps (Build, Run, Compare), a Show details switch, keyboard shortcuts, and every word of copy in one file. Later issues restyle each page on top of it.

## 2. Background

**Design authority:** `docs/design/APPLE_DESIGN.md` (added by K-43). Direction "soft sheets": flat solid colours, hairline borders, one whisper shadow, translucent top bar and dock (`backdrop-filter`, solid fallback under `prefers-reduced-transparency` and `prefers-contrast: more`), no gradients except the scroll-edge fade, no glows, neon, purple, emoji icons or monospace fonts. System sans-serif only; numbers use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

**Palette (final):** light canvas `#F2F3F1`, surface `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1F1D`, muted `#5B625E`, border `#CFD3D0`, accent teal `#0B5E6B`, red `#B42318`, amber `#8A4B00`, green `#1D7A34`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Dark: canvas `#121513`, surface `#1B1F1D`, text `#ECEFED`, muted `#A3ABA6`, border `#343A37`, accent `#5FB6C4`, red `#F0877C`, amber `#E0A24A`, green `#6FCB87`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Chart gray is for chart marks and rules only, never text.

**Rules that do not change (CLAUDE.md rule 7, PRD §7 and §8):** classic scripts on `window.APRM`, no ES modules, no `fetch`, no framework, no build step; works from `file://` offline; `textContent` only for user, file, URL and engine text; loading, empty and error states on every view; colours as CSS variables with light and dark values; Chart.js only in Compare, pinned with SRI, with a table fallback. Nothing here touches `core/`, `wasm/` or PRD §5, and every number shown must equal the engine JSON.

**Tone:** short plain sentences, sentence case, talk to the user. Plain words first, technical term beside them ("Shortest job first (SJF)"). Engine sentences (why log, validation errors) are shown verbatim; the UI may add a plain lead-in but never rewrites them. "Show details" (K-43) reveals the full technical view: exact numbers, raw aged keys, heap order, log kinds.

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- `web/css/tokens.css` (colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, light and dark) and `web/css/components.css` (segmented control, buttons, cards, inputs, table, toast, hint, empty state, disclosure, switch, focus ring)
- `web/js/copy.js` (APRM.copy: every label, hint, empty state and error lead-in), `web/js/motion.js` (small spring helper, reduced-motion aware), `web/js/keys.js` (Space plays or pauses, Right arrow steps; ignored inside fields and buttons)
- New top bar: title, segmented control `1 Build / 2 Run / 3 Compare`, Show details switch (saved in `localStorage` inside try/catch), engine status; one page visible at a time; the always-visible Machine/Jobs/Timeline/Why/Metrics dashboard is removed from Build and Compare; a Next button at the bottom of Build and Run
- Copy `AppleSKILL.md` to `docs/design/APPLE_DESIGN.md`; PRD §7 script table gains copy.js, motion.js, keys.js (PRD §5 untouched)
- Impeccable `PRODUCT.md` (product context from Krishna's answers)

**Out of scope:**

- Restyling Build, Run and Compare page bodies (K-44, K-45, K-46)
- Any change to core/, wasm/ or PRD §5

## 5. Specification

Store gains `details` (boolean, default false). `APRM.copy.get(key)` returns a string and throws on an unknown key (tests list every key used in index.html and js/). `APRM.keys.mount()` handles `keydown` on `document`: Space calls `APRM.player` play/pause toggle, ArrowRight calls step; it returns without acting when `event.target` is an input, textarea, select, button or contenteditable, or a modifier key is held. `APRM.motion.spring(el, props, {damping, response})` animates `transform` and `opacity` only and does nothing under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Segmented control is a `role=tablist`-free group of buttons with `aria-pressed`, keyboard focusable; Left/Right does not conflict with step (arrows only step in Run when focus is not in the control).

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Write tests/web/check_contrast.mjs and test_copy.mjs first
2. Add tokens.css and components.css; wire into index.html
3. Add copy.js, motion.js, keys.js; update script order in PRD §7 and test_web.mjs
4. Build the shell and Show details switch; remove the duplicate dashboard from Build and Compare
5. Run all node tests and a file:// check; screenshots light and dark before and after

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| check_contrast | Every text and UI pair in tokens.css, light and dark | Text pairs at least 4.5, UI pairs at least 3 (chart gray excluded from text) |
| copy-keys | Every copy key used in HTML and JS exists | No missing keys, no unused keys |
| keys | Space and Right arrow outside fields; ignored in inputs, with modifiers | Play/pause and step happen only when allowed |
| shell | Steps switch pages; one page visible; details flag saved and survives blocked storage | Pass with and without localStorage |
| script-order | index.html scripts follow the updated PRD §7 order | Pass |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] tokens.css and components.css exist, with light and dark values for every colour variable
- [ ] All user-facing text comes from copy.js
- [ ] Segmented steps, Next buttons, Show details switch and Space/Right arrow work; Space never fires inside a field
- [ ] Contrast script passes; reduced motion, reduced transparency and increased contrast fallbacks exist
- [ ] `node tests/web/*.mjs` and `make test` green; opens from file:// offline
- [ ] Before and after screenshots of the shell (light and dark) are in the PR

## 9. How to verify

`node tests/web/test_web.mjs && node tests/web/check_contrast.mjs && node tests/web/test_copy.mjs && node tests/web/test_keys.mjs`; then `make wasm` and open `web/index.html` with the network off.

## 10. Viva notes

Design tokens mean one place for every colour and spacing value; the UI never decides scheduling. Examiner question: "Is Show details just decoration?" No: it reveals the exact numbers, aged keys and log kinds the engine returns, unchanged.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Shortcuts firing while typing
- Dark mode colours drifting from the palette
- Breaking element ids that tests/web/*.mjs rely on; keep ids stable
